summary: Completed comprehensive testing of standardized error format and validation features. All 16 backend tests passed. Frontend inline validation working correctly for signup, login, and dashboard forms. Fixed a bug in API interceptor that was preventing login error alerts from displaying.

fixed_bugs.issue: 401 interceptor was redirecting to /login even when already on login/signup page, preventing error alerts from displaying
fixed_bugs.fix: Added check to skip redirect when already on auth pages (login/signup)

backend: POST /api/auth/login with wrong password returns INVALID_CREDENTIALS with clear message
POST /api/auth/signup with existing email returns EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS
GET /api/v1/agents/{fake_id} returns AGENT_NOT_FOUND with agent_id in details
POST /api/v1/webhooks with invalid URL returns INVALID_URL
Signup with invalid email format returns VALIDATION_ERROR with field-level error
Signup with short password returns VALIDATION_ERROR with field-level error
Signup with missing email returns VALIDATION_ERROR with field-level error
Signup with missing password returns VALIDATION_ERROR with field-level error
Create agent with missing name returns VALIDATION_ERROR with field-level error
Create agent with empty name returns VALIDATION_ERROR
Request with invalid token returns TOKEN_INVALID/INVALID_API_KEY
Invalid webhook event type returns INVALID_ENUM_VALUE
Invalid outcome result value returns VALIDATION_ERROR with field-level error
Invalid outcome submitter_type returns VALIDATION_ERROR with field-level error
frontend: Signup form: Invalid email shows inline error 'Please enter a valid email address.'
Signup form: Short password shows inline error 'Password must be at least 6 characters.'
Signup form: Mismatched passwords shows inline error 'Passwords do not match.'
Signup form: Red border on invalid fields
Login form: Empty email shows inline error 'Email is required.'
Login form: Empty password shows inline error 'Password is required.'
Login form: Invalid credentials shows error alert 'Invalid email or password. Please check your credentials and try again.'
Dashboard agent form: Submit button disabled when name is empty
Dashboard agent form: Submit button enabled when name is filled
Dashboard webhook form: Submit button disabled when URL is empty
Dashboard webhook form: Invalid URL shows inline error 'URL must start with http:// or https://'

critical_code_review_comments: Standardized error format {error: {code, message, details}} is correctly implemented across all endpoints
Field-level validation errors are properly returned with user-friendly messages
Frontend inline validation provides good UX with red borders and error messages below fields
Login error alert now displays correctly after fixing the API interceptor bug
seed_data_creation: Test users created with unique UUIDs for each test run
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validation and error handling features fully tested. Backend returns standardized error format {error: {code, message, details}} for all error cases. Frontend shows inline validation with red borders and error messages. Fixed bug in api.js where 401 interceptor was redirecting even on login page.

error_codes_tested.AGENT_NOT_FOUND: Get non-existent agent (includes agent_id in details)
